package.name: C2000Ware_devices
package.description: Welcome to C2000Ware! C2000Ware for C2000 microcontrollers is a cohesive set of development software and documentation designed to minimize software development time. From device-specific drivers and libraries to device peripheral examples, C2000Ware provides a solid foundation to begin development and evaluation of your product.

package.name: Sitara Devices
package.description: Welcome to Sitara Resource Explorer! Quicken your development time with Sitara Resource Explorer, a tool for navigating the available resources that support Sitara devices. Using this GUI or clicking through the folder tree to the left, we offer software libraries, datasheets, app notes and other resources - all at the tip of your fingers.
